name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Zero-Restart Theme Switching: Switching themes no longer triggers Android launcher alias changes or app restarts when icon sync is off.
Sync App Icon With Theme: App launcher icon only syncs and updates when explicitly toggled ON; turning it off completely locks the icon and keeps the app running without any resets.
Cold-Start Guard: Ensured cold start restores theme and colors instantly without unnecessary launcher component reconfiguration.
